title: Preparation and Test of UV Resistant and Flame Retardant Cotton Fabric With Phytic Acid, Tannic Acid and Diethylenetriamine as Raw Materials
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Original and treated cotton fabrics; Table 3.5 and Figure 3.6 use CF-DETA, CF-DETA-TA and CF-DETA-TA-PA.
source_material_form_LOI_raw: Cotton fabric strips, 150 × 58 mm2; Table 3.1 named initial treated fabrics.
washing_state: Initial prepared fabric after ethanol and distilled-water rinses of the amination step; no durability laundering
TGA_specimen_preparation: Aliquot of the same prepared cotton fabric; specimen mass, cutting or grinding, crucible and gas flow not reported.

TG_locator: Original PDF p.16 Table 3.5 (caption p.15); p.8 section 3.7; Figure 3.6 graphs p.20 with caption p.21.
conditions_locator: Original PDF p.4 section 2.1.2 and LOI method; p.5 section 2.2 item8 TG method.
source_access_method: Complete original 23-page Research Square v1 PDF downloaded; all text/tables/captions reviewed and original LOI/TG tables plus TG/DTG plots visually checked. No final-journal method or value used.
source_location: PDF pp.4–5 preparation and methods; pp.5–6 measured LOI; p.8 TG prose; pp.15–16 Tables 3.1/3.5; pp.20–21 Figure 3.6.
source_Rmax_unit: %/°C as printed; derivative-axis label only says derivative weight (%), so no rate-basis conversion
limitations: Author preprint v 1, not a claim of peer-reviewed journal publication. Cotton construction, areal mass and supplier are not reported. The source describes an oil bath with a water temperature of 85 °C; bath medium is unresolved and not silently corrected. The 50% phytic-acid stock percentage basis is unspecified. LOI/TG replicate count, uncertainty and conditioning are not reported; the cone-calorimetry twice-per-sample statement is not transferred. Rmax units and plot derivative-axis notation are retained raw; no conversion is made. The FTIR captions refer to TA/TA-Cu although the plotted legends name the CF/DETA series, and the mechanical method mentions paper/paperboard; these unrelated source editorial errors are disclosed. Control LOI 16.5 has a literature citation in section 3.1 and is held pending provenance clarification. Reduced 25/50/75% DTP recipes have LOI but no matching exact TG and are held. Final-journal version not identified in the reviewed source; future matching author/title or numerical observations require version-family reuse review.
treatment_method: Treat a 30 × 8 cm² cotton piece with 30 mL DMF and 20 mL epichlorohydrin at the source-reported 85 °C bath temperature for 1.5 h; slowly add 1.5 mL DETA and stir for 1 h. Rinse several times with ethanol, then repeatedly with distilled water, and air-oven dry at 70 °C until fully dry.
pairing_evidence: Own measured-LOI Table 3.1 and TG Table 3.5 explicitly share the exact CF-DETA label. Section 2.1.2 defines each sequentially prepared fabric, and section 3.7/labelled TG–DTG plots concern the same initial series. Preparatory rinse is retained; no laundering or reduced-DTP recipe is substituted.
